basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer from Portland, Oregon, with a passion for all things curly hair. Apart from spending time perfecting my hair care routine, I enjoy exploring hidden gems in indie films, especially within the mystery genre, and playing Rocket League during my downtime. As a recent parent, I've found myself diving into parenting subreddits to navigate the toddler years. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. I'm in a long-term relationship and often share my partner's interests in music and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having dealt with curly hair all my life, I've become something of a self-taught expert. I spend a lot of time researching and testing various products and techniques, often sharing my findings on forums like /r/curlyhair. My career in software development keeps me engaged with technology and problem-solving daily.
